courses.title: Systems Thinking for Marketing Managers
courses.description: Systems Thinking for Marketing Managers takes you from the basics of systems thinking to applying it on a realistic Senior Marketing Manager scenario, through short lessons and hands-on practice. Along the way, you'll also get a practical introduction to executive presentation skills, enough to use it alongside systems thinking day to day. Expect a practical course, not a lecture-heavy one.
learning_outcomes: Applying systems thinking to a real Senior Marketing Manager scenario
Practicing systems thinking through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to executive presentation skills
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying brand strategy on your own.
